user default on >continuo ~* &* +@all
user continuo_dead_letter_controller on >local-continuo_dead_letter_controller ~continuo:* -@all +ping +hello +client|setinfo +xinfo|groups +xadd +xreadgroup +xack +xautoclaim +xclaim +xpending +xinfo|consumers +xgroup|delconsumer +xrange +xtrim +xlen +del +info
user continuo_execution_controller on >local-continuo_execution_controller ~continuo:task.dispatch:v1 %W~continuo:consumer.dead_letter:v1 -@all +ping +hello +client|setinfo +xinfo|groups +xadd +xreadgroup +xack +xautoclaim +xclaim +xpending +xinfo|consumers +xgroup|delconsumer
user continuo_run_controller on >local-continuo_run_controller %W~continuo:consumer.dead_letter:v1 %W~continuo:outbox.dead_letter:v1 %W~continuo:task.dispatch:v1 -@all +ping +hello +client|setinfo +xinfo|groups +xadd
user continuo_redis_migrate on >local-continuo_redis_migrate ~continuo:* -@all +ping +hello +client|setinfo +xgroup|create +xgroup|destroy +xinfo|groups +exists
user continuo_ui on >local-continuo_ui ~continuo:uisession:* -@all +ping +hello +client|setinfo +xinfo|groups +get +set +del +expire
